data.name: Urielus
data.gender_notes: Urielus is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Hebrew, Uriel means ‘God is my light.’ In Christian tradition, Uriel is an angel, the name of a chief angel, and a saint. Uriel is one of the seven archangels named in Hebrew tradition. He is considered to be the angel of light. The name Urielus carries the meaning “God of Light” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Urielus usually hope their child will grow to embody god of light and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Urielus belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “God of Light.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Urielus total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_hebrew.name: אויראלוס
in_hebrew.long_meaning: אויראלוס הוא שם שמשמעותו 'אלוהים הוא אור שלי' או 'אור האלוהים'. השם מורכב מהמילים 'אויר' שפירושו 'אלוהים הוא אור' ו'אלוס' שפירושו 'שלי' או 'הוא'. השם אויראלוס קשור לשם אויראל, אחד מהמלאכים המוזכרים בספר החיים של היהודי הנודע יצחק בן אברהם אקרישמן.

in_greek.name: Οὐριήλους
in_greek.long_meaning: Οὐριήλους είναι ένα όνομα που σημαίνει 'Θεός είναι το φως μου' ή 'Το φως του Θεού'. Το όνομα προέρχεται από τις λέξεις 'Οὐριήλ' που σημαίνει 'Θεός είναι το φως' και την κατάληξη '-ους' που δηλώνει κτήση ή σχέση. Ο Ουριήλ είναι ένας από τους αρχαγγέλους στην παράδοση της Εκκλησίας.

in_latin.name: Urielus
in_latin.long_meaning: Urielus nomen significat 'Deus est lux mea' vel 'Lux Dei'. Nomen componitur ex 'Uriel' quod 'Deus est lux' significat et sufficit '-us' quod possessionem vel relationem indicat. Uriel est unus ex archangelis in traditione Ecclesiae.

in_english.name: Urielus
in_english.meaning: God is my light or Light of God
in_english.long_meaning: Urielus is a Christian name that signifies 'God is my light' or 'Light of God'. The name is derived from the Hebrew roots 'Uri' meaning 'God is my light' and the suffix '-el' or '-us' indicating possession or relation. Uriel is one of the archangels in Christian tradition, often associated with wisdom, illumination, and the burning of incense. The name Urielus conveys spiritual meaning, personality traits of illumination, and guidance.

data.cultural_impact: Urielus is a Christian name that holds deep cultural significance, as it is derived from the Hebrew word Uriel, which translates to 'God is my light.' In Christian tradition, Uriel is renowned as an angel, specifically one of the seven archangels, further emphasizing the celestial and divine connection. Additionally, Uriel is revered as a saint in some Christian denominations. The name Urielus carries an abundant sense of spiritual guidance, knowledge, and protection – reflecting the belief in the presence and power of the divine, even in everyday life.
data.spiritual_significance: As the name Urielus is derived from the Hebrew word Uriel, it embodies the promise 'God is my light.' This spiritual significance runs deep, as it highlights the idea of guiding light and wise knowledge from the divine. The name Urielus conveys a connection to one's faith and spirituality, reminding the individual of God's presence and the power of divine intervention. It's a reminder that even in the darkest times, one can look to the power of the divine for guidance, courage, and strength.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Uriel, meaning "God is my light," is an angelic name in Christian tradition, symbolizing enlightenment, guidance, and protection from the divine light.
